explain.text: Ten weeks is $\tfrac{120}{52} \approx 2.31$ months. £10,000 × 2.31 ≈ £23,077 and £14,000 × 2.31 ≈ £32,308, so about £23,000 to £32,000. Quantt reported these as summer 2026 figures.

ideas: Banks run strats and quant research desks for clients. Hedge funds invest for investors; trading firms trade their own money.
Turn reported pay into internship pay: weekly × weeks, or annual × weeks/52. Reported figures are third-party and vary.
A hedge fund and a market maker can share a name and be separate firms. Judge every role by its tasks, not the label.
summary.trap: A rejection from one firm with a shared name is not a rejection from the other.
